**What can be said:** PR #25682 makes the anonymous public-form submit door (ADR-0138 D2 class 1) carry no file, under ruling C. This card is ruling C's rule at ADR-0138 D2's other anonymous write classes. Reach needs a deployment grant (the default empty state denies); the first step is a measurement.

**Business reason:** ruling C's rule, an anonymous submission carries no file, should hold at every anonymous write door, not only at the form door; a deployment that opens a guest write should not reopen what C closed.

**Dedupe:** the titles of every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue updated since 2026-10-10, open and closed (1,229 read), matched on `claim|copy-on|file id|download|unowned|orphan|sys_file|file reference|guest.*file|anonymous.*file|storage.*(auth|scope)|file.*organi`. 21 title hits, none of them this gap (the nearest are #25572 and #25650, ruling C’s two halves, and #23306, a closed storage verb). **New.**
